name: Structure
title: 一份提醒，来自内部协作

lines.zh: SoundBridge，为听障人士设计的环境感知手表。
lines.en: SoundBridge: an environmental awareness watch for deaf and hard-of-hearing people.

lines.zh: 收音、识别，再以画面与振动反馈。
lines.en: Capture sound, identify it, then respond through visuals and vibration.

name: Logic
title: 声音与姿态，共同生成提示
en: SOUND AND WRIST ORIENTATION, WORKING TOGETHER

lines.zh: 四路收音，端侧AI识别车铃和鸣笛，同时估算来向。
lines.en: Four microphones feed on-device AI to recognize bells and horns, alongside direction estimation.

lines.zh: 加入手腕姿态，更新相对当前表盘的方向。
lines.en: Wrist orientation updates direction relative to the current watch face.

lines.zh: 触觉唤起注意，视觉补充信息。
lines.en: Touch gets attention. Visuals add context.

name: Opening
title: 跟随小林，走上一段日常道路
en: FOLLOW XIAOLIN ON AN EVERYDAY JOURNEY

lines.zh: 现在，跟随听障使用者小林，走上一段日常道路。
lines.en: Now follow Xiaolin, a deaf or hard-of-hearing user, on an everyday journey.

name: Approach
title: 身后的车铃，抵达手腕
en: A BELL BEHIND HER. A CUE ON HER WRIST.

lines.zh: 骑行者从左后方接近，车铃响起。
lines.en: A cyclist approaches from behind on the left and rings a bell.

lines.zh: 手表识别车铃，用三次短振引起注意。
lines.en: The watch identifies the bell and gives three short pulses.

lines.zh: 小林抬腕，手表更新方位。姿态稳定后，显示方向。
lines.en: As Xiaolin raises her wrist, direction updates. The angle and pointer appear once the pose settles.

lines.zh: 她回头确认，靠边让行。
lines.en: She looks around and makes space for the cyclist.

name: Array
title: 声源在移动，方位随之更新
en: THE SOURCE MOVES. THE DIRECTION UPDATES.

lines.zh: 比较四路到达时差，估算来向。
lines.en: Differences in arrival time across four microphones help estimate direction.

lines.zh: 骑行者经过时，声源、角度和方位标记同步变化。
lines.en: As the cyclist passes, the source, angle and pointer move together.

name: RoadSounds
title: 听见更多，提醒更有分寸

lines.zh: AI还可以区分警笛、车辆运行声和施工声。
lines.en: AI can also distinguish sirens, vehicle sounds and construction.

lines.zh: 背景底噪减少打扰，重要事件以不同节奏提示。
lines.en: Background sound causes fewer interruptions. Important events receive distinct patterns.

name: Bearing
title: 手腕转动，指向也要重新计算
en: A TURNING WRIST NEEDS AN UPDATED DIRECTION

lines.zh: 手臂下垂时，先提醒类别；抬腕后，结合姿态更新方向。
lines.en: With the arm down, show sound class first. On raising the wrist, use its orientation to update direction.

lines.zh: 不必刻意保持水平。姿态稳定时显示指向，晃动时暂缓显示。
lines.en: No exact horizontal pose is required. Show direction when stable and withhold it during movement.

lines.zh: 角度相对当前表盘，不是身体朝向。
lines.en: The angle is relative to the current watch face, not the body.

name: Crossing
title: 车辆提示出现，她还没有查看
en: A VEHICLE CUE. NO VIEWING RESPONSE YET.

lines.zh: 路口车辆靠近，手表识别鸣笛，发出两次长振。
lines.en: A vehicle approaches. The watch recognizes its horn and gives two long pulses.

lines.zh: 这一次，小林暂时没有抬腕。提醒不会就此消失。
lines.en: This time Xiaolin has not raised her wrist yet. The reminder does not simply disappear.

name: Escalation
title: 尚未确认，提醒继续跟进

lines.zh: 手臂仍下垂，只表示尚未观察到查看动作。
lines.en: An arm still down only means no viewing gesture has been observed.

lines.zh: 车辆提示持续而未确认，手表间隔重复，并逐步增强振动。
lines.en: While the vehicle cue persists without acknowledgment, pulses repeat with pauses and gradually increase.

lines.zh: 抬腕后显示方向；点按确认，停止升级，继续观察路况。
lines.en: Raise to view direction. Tap to acknowledge, stop escalation and keep observing the road.

name: Wait
title: 确认提醒，然后观察路况
en: ACKNOWLEDGE THE CUE. CHECK THE ROAD.

lines.zh: 确认提醒不代表道路安全。小林在路缘内观察车辆。
lines.en: Acknowledging a cue does not mean the road is clear. Xiaolin watches from behind the curb.

lines.zh: 等车辆通过，确认路况再走。
lines.en: She lets the vehicle pass and checks the road before moving.

lines.zh: 在安全位置，调整振动强度和文字大小。
lines.en: In a safe place, adjust vibration strength and text size.

lines.zh: 重复提醒有间隔和时限，不会无休止振动。
lines.en: Repeated reminders include pauses and a time limit instead of endless vibration.

lines.zh: 另一位骑行者从右后方接近，短振再次提醒她。
lines.en: Another cyclist approaches from behind on the right. Short pulses alert her again.

lines.zh: 小林抬腕查看，转头确认，让出空间。
lines.en: Xiaolin checks her wrist, looks around and makes space.

name: Closing
title: 及时察觉，更从容地出行

lines.zh: SoundBridge，为听障人士出行，提供及时的线索。
lines.en: SoundBridge brings timely cues to independent journeys for deaf and hard-of-hearing people.
